text: Android: self-heal a missing accountId so pre-v1.2.0 sessions can detect collaborator changes

Fixed db5fd04 — SyncEngine.ensureAccountId() backfills a null accountId best-effort by matching sessionState.accountEmail against any list's members roster (account_id + email), self-healing in the background worker without a re-login. Verified: new SyncEngineTest test + full Android suite + lint clean.
